name: Michael
source:
Michael is a high-ranking archangel in the Celestial Realm. He has not yet officially appeared in Obey Me!, but has been mentioned by other characters, including Luke, who has stated that he "reports to Michael directly." 

[From [url=https://obeymewiki.com/wiki/Michael]The Obey Me Wiki[/url]]
